question: The next symbol is ]. What happens?
context: The round compartment from position 2 was just closed. The top of the pile is now [, opened at position 1.

choices.label: Pop [: the square lid fits
choices.feedback: Right. The square compartment is the most recently opened one still open, and a square lid fits it, so it comes off the pile.

choices.label: Push ] onto the pile
choices.feedback: Only opening symbols go on the pile. A closing symbol is compared with the top and, if it fits, removes it.

choices.label: Stop: the log is wrong
choices.feedback: Not here. The lid only has to fit the top of the pile, which is [. The curly compartment underneath waits its turn.
